text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a tidy set of runbook edits and clear owners. I sketched a tiny plan below.

marc: 👍 can you paste the change list?

ashley: TL;DR: 1) Add explicit triage checklist for cache-eviction alerts, 2) Add diagnostic commands + where to find logs, 3) Escalation path for cross-region failover, 4) Add recurring incident detection section (pattern window = 24h, threshold = 3 events).

priya: I can own the cache-eviction checklist. I'll add the kubectl + redis-cli commands.

jenny: I'll write the escalation path including stakeholder pages and paging escalation times. Need to know SLAs for Dedicated customers to include.

ashley: Owners noted: priya (cache triage), jenny (escalation), marc (diagnostics + automated drills), ashley (merge + rollout). Target: initial edits by EOD Friday.

marc: Will draft diagnostics section. Proposed commands snippet to include:
```
# check pod resource pressure
kubectl top pods -n inference
# inspect redis eviction stats
redis-cli INFO memory | grep evicted_keys
# grab recent logs (last 200 lines)
kubectl logs deploy/inference-runtime -n inference --tail=200
```

priya: Adding a short run of manual mitigation steps too:
1) Increase cache TTL for critical routes
2) Temporarily scale dedicated pool by +1 GPU (if SLA allows)
3) Trigger prefix cache warm-up job

incident-bot: Note: linked postmortem: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/2360009000-cache-evict.json (auto-link)

jenny: For escalation, propose: on-call -> eng-sre lead (10m) -> infra pager (30m) -> exec alert (60m). Will map to rotation in Ops calendar.

ashley: Also: add a short section for "Recurring pattern detection" with an example query for DataDog/Prometheus. Marc, can you paste a promql?

marc: Sure, example PromQL: `count_over_time(inference_cache_evictions[24h]) > 3` — plus a label filter for region and customer_tier. I'll add alert thresholds and runbook links.

priya: Filing the action items in the postmortem tracker now. Quick note on timelines in the tracker: owners set due dates, set a reminder for weekly check-in until closed.

ashley: Perfect. Two more items: add an optional canary rollback step (how to pin model to previous variant) and short blameless note about noisy retries.

jenny: I'll include a blameless template paragraph and link to the customer comms checklist.

marc: Draft will be in the /docs/runbooks/cache-eviction.md PR by Thu 5pm PDT.

priya: I'll push my commands and mitigation steps by Thu EOD.

ashley: Great — final merge by Friday 11:59pm. If anyone can't hit that, ping here with blockers.

marc: no blockers atm.

jenny: one item — need SLA numbers from finance for Dedicated customers. @ashley can you pull?

ashley: Yep, I'll fetch and post to the thread.

incident-bot: Reminder: weekly remediation check-in scheduled for next Tue 10:00 AM PT.

ashley: Thanks all. We'll review next Tue and confirm recurring-pattern alerts are live. :thumbsup:
